subject: math
decisions: 116 sprint first (owner, 2026-11-15): review chapters for students who studied grade 10–11 in school; the full zero-to-hero core follows for 117.
Codes shared by 11A and 11B are reviewed in one chapter on both paths (math map D1).
★/＃ codes (N-10-5, N-10-7, G-10-1, D-10-1) are reviewed as short toolbox chapters or inside a related chapter; ※ material (cot/sec/csc, the Cauchy note) is left out of the sprint.

Outline approved by the owner on 2026-11-15 (S1 gate).
Owner approved (2026-11-16) the cross-unit part and the optional 分科 advanced-tools track (docs/curriculum/math-extensions-proposal.md).
openQuestions: Exam-item links (examItems) are added per chapter in S2 from src/data/registry/exam/items/math.json.
Reviewed concepts (reviews) are added per chapter in S2, once their glossary entries exist.
